**Duration:** July 2023 – Present
**Location:** Chennai, India
**Client:** Prudential Finance
**Project:** ECM – Documentum Modernization

Working as a System Engineer at TCS, specializing in Angular development for Prudential Finance's Enterprise Content Management platform. The project involves modernizing legacy .NET applications by migrating them to Angular-based single-page applications.

#### Legacy Migration
- Migrated legacy .NET (ASP.NET WebForms/MVC) front-end modules into Angular 15+, replacing server-rendered postback pages with a single-page application architecture for improved performance, scalability, and modern UX.

#### Component Development
- Developed and maintained 40+ reusable Angular components for document import, approval workflows, search, and reporting modules of an Enterprise Content Management platform (OpenText Documentum) used for records management in the insurance domain.

#### UI Development
- Built responsive, cross-browser UI using Angular Material, Angular CDK, Bootstrap 5, and SCSS, ensuring consistent behavior across Chrome, Edge, and Firefox.

#### State Management
- Implemented cross-component state management and real-time data synchronization using RxJS Subjects and BehaviorSubjects within shared Angular services.

#### API Integration
- Collaborated with backend .NET teams to define, validate, and integrate REST API contracts using Angular HttpClient, applying RxJS operators (switchMap, catchError, retry) for resilient data handling and error recovery.

#### Database
- Wrote SQL queries against Microsoft SQL Server to validate API responses, reproduce reported data discrepancies, and verify document metadata and workflow states while debugging front-end issues.

#### Access Control & Workflows
- Implemented role-based access control and multi-stage approval workflows driven by Business Unit (BU) and Functional Group (FG) requirements, including role-based routing and conditional UI rendering.

#### Forms & Validation
- Built complex dynamic forms using Angular Reactive Forms with custom validators, cross-field validation, and conditional field logic; developed custom directives and pipes for input validation (decimal precision, alphanumeric, currency formatting) and metadata display.

#### Performance Optimization
- Optimized front-end performance by implementing lazy-loaded feature modules with a PreloadAllModules preloading strategy to keep the initial bundle small while making subsequent route navigation instant (reducing page load times by 20%).

- Applied OnPush Change Detection, Angular CDK virtual scrolling and offloaded table filtering, sorting, and pagination to a Web Worker to eliminate main-thread UI freezes on large datasets.

#### Internationalization
- Implemented internationalization (i18n) with ngx-translate supporting runtime language switching across English, Spanish, and Japanese with persisted user preference.

#### Dashboards & Reporting
- Developed audit trail dashboards and compliance reporting interfaces using Chart.js, including interactive pie and bar charts with click-through drill-down and Excel export.

#### Testing
- Developed unit tests with Jasmine and Karma covering Angular components and services, and validated releases through regression testing to catch defects before deployment.

#### Agile & Collaboration
- Worked in cross-functional teams with backend developers, QA engineers, and business stakeholders to translate Business Unit requirements into delivered features; established front-end coding standards and best-practices documentation, and conducted peer code reviews via Git/GitHub pull requests within Agile sprints (planning, stand-ups, retrospectives).

#### CI/CD
- Supported CI/CD pipelines built on GitHub Actions for automated Angular builds and multi-environment deployments with JFrog Artifactory release bundles, and assisted in troubleshooting staging and production environment issues.

#### AI-Assisted Development
- Applied AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate component scaffolding, refactoring, and unit-test generation, and to navigate and document a large legacy codebase – reviewing and validating all generated output against project coding standards before merge.

- Reduced page load times by 20% through lazy loading, component refactoring, and render optimization.
- Improved form data accuracy by implementing client-side validations, input sanitization, custom validation directives, and structured error handling, measurably reducing invalid submissions.

- Improved perceived application responsiveness through loading indicators, progress states, and optimized component rendering on data-heavy screens.
- Contributed to automating builds and deployments, reducing manual deployment effort by 30%.
- Participated in the TCS Generative AI Hackathon as part of continuous learning in emerging technologies.

**Type:** Personal Project
**Duration:** November 2026
**Role:** Full-Stack Developer

A responsive personal portfolio website with an integrated AI-powered chatbot using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The chatbot acts as a virtual professional representative, answering questions about professional background using verified portfolio information.

Traditional portfolios provide static information. This project demonstrates both frontend engineering expertise and practical Generative AI implementation by combining a professional portfolio with an interactive AI assistant.

- **Frontend:** Angular 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons
- **Backend:** Cloudflare Pages Functions
- **AI/LLM:** Cloudflare Workers AI (GLM-4.7-flash)
- **Embeddings:** BAAI BGE (bge-base-en-v1.5)
- **Retrieval:** Cosine similarity over JSON vector index
- **Hosting:** Cloudflare Pages (free tier)
- **Source Control:** GitHub
